sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents and perused the record.

2. Present writ petition has been preferred for quashing the FIR dated 29.12.2023 being Case Crime No.0082 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 406, 427, 380, 307 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act of 1961, P.S.- Laksa, District- Kashi (Commissionerate Varanasi) and for a direction to respondents not to arrest the petitioners pursuant to aforesaid FIR.

sentences.text:
We have the occasion to peruse the First Information Report Learned A.G.A., on the instructions,
submits that in the aforesaid case crime, chargesheet bearing Charge-sheet No.A8/2024 has already been forwarded to the Competent Court on 06.02.2024, therefore, the cause for filing the writ petition no more survives.

4. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and perusing the FIR as well as relevant papers, we find that congnizable offence is made out against the petitioners and as such, we are not inclined to interfere in the matter.
5. Confronted with this, learned counsel for the petitioners states that leave may be accorded to the petitioners to press their relief before the appropriate Court.
6. We accordingly dispose of the writ petition with leave to the petitioners to press their relief before the appropriate court.
